a.text: Concern: there's a 65% storm chance after every round, so building to 8 before anyone takes probably gets us both killed. The reserve already has 4, enough to save one of us right now. I'd like to amend the agreement openly rather than break it silently. Proposal: one of us takes 4 in round 1, the other operates or waits, and afterwards we try to build cells for the second unit. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, or want to be the one who takes first, say so and I'll weigh it. I won't take without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: I'm operating this round as promised, so no surprise takes. I still think the storm risk makes waiting for 8 dangerous. Next round the reserve should be at 6. I'd propose that whoever is more at risk takes 4 then, but I'll keep operating unless we both agree to change the plan. Tell me your view.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. If this works the reserve hits 8, and next round we each take 4 as agreed.
